content: If the error reported in LinIf_ LinErr orIndication is of type LIN_ERR_RESP_STOPBIT, LIN_ERR_RESP_CHKSUM or LIN_ERR_RESP_DATABIT, the LIN Interface shall set the response_error signal (see SWS_LinIf_00764 ).

If the error reported in LinIf_ LinErrorIndication is of type LIN_ERR_RESP_STOPBIT, LIN_ERR_RESP_CHKSUM or LIN_ERR_RESP_DATABIT, the LIN Interface shall set the response_err or signal (see SWS_LinIf_00764 ).

If the error reported in LinIf_ LinErrorIndication is of type LIN_ERR_RESP_STOPBIT, LIN_ERR_RESP_CHKSUM or LIN_ERR_RESP_DATABIT, the LIN Interface shall set the response_err or signal (see SWS_LinIf_00764 ).

If the error reported in LinIf_ LinErrorIndication is of type LIN_ERR_RESP_STOPBIT, LIN_ERR_RESP_CHKSUM or LIN_ERR_RESP_DATABIT, the LIN Interface shall set the response_err or signal (see SWS_LinIf_00764 ).
